methodology: dual: opaque whole-record transplants + R^n cosine probes
purpose: Test whether two independently stored facts become indivisible (fuse) during computation and later separate (fission). Disagreements between opaque and R^n methods are breakpoints revealing native structure.
success_criterion: At least one SEPARATE→FUSED or FUSED→SEPARATE transition detected, reproducible across prompt variants
breakpoint_criterion: Layer where transplant behavioral outcome disagrees with R^n cosine similarity prediction
